about: Inputs from the platform's parity fixture (src/lib/engines/__tests__/fixtures/python-parity.json) plus one year-guard case; expected is the exact output of run(inputs). The platform's parity test checks these outputs against the Python reference engines of the 6 Nov 2026 A/B test (Malta: against an independent Python reference, mt-income-tax.test.ts).

headline.label: Lowest total tax for the couple, basis year 2026 (year of assessment 2027): joint computation with spouse B's part-time profit at the 10% final tax

steps: Basis year 2026 is year of assessment 2027; status, custody and residence are tested in the basis year
Joint: 2 child(ren) in the couple's custody, 2 qualifying: the married 2 children table
A, joint: EUR 98,056.42 on the married 2 children table: EUR 98,056.42 x 35% - EUR 12,575.00 = EUR 21,744.75
Separate: each spouse uses the article 56(1)(b) tables: spouse A the parent 2 children table, spouse B the parent 2 children table
B, separate, spouse A: EUR 94,070.42 on the parent 2 children table: EUR 94,070.42 x 35% - EUR 11,325.00 = EUR 21,599.65
B, separate, spouse B: EUR 3,986.00 on the parent 2 children table is within the 0% band (up to EUR 18,500.00): EUR 0.00
Part-time: EUR 3,986.00 of spouse B's EUR 3,986.00 part-time profit (cap EUR 12,000.00) x 10% = EUR 398.60 final tax; EUR 0.00 stays in the return
C, joint: EUR 94,070.42 on the married 2 children table: EUR 94,070.42 x 35% - EUR 12,575.00 = EUR 20,349.65
C, separate, spouse A: EUR 94,070.42 on the parent 2 children table: EUR 94,070.42 x 35% - EUR 11,325.00 = EUR 21,599.65
C, separate, spouse B: EUR 0.00 on the parent 2 children table is within the 0% band (up to EUR 18,500.00): EUR 0.00
A_joint (joint computation on the married table): total EUR 21,744.75
B_separate (separate computation, each spouse on the single or parent table): total EUR 21,599.65
C_joint_10pct (joint computation with spouse B's part-time profit at the 10% final tax): total EUR 20,748.25
C_separate_10pct (separate computation with spouse B's part-time profit at the 10% final tax): total EUR 21,998.25
Lowest: C_joint_10pct, EUR 20,748.25, EUR 996.50 less than the joint computation

constants_used.name: QUALIFYING_CHILD_NATIONALITY
constants_used.quote:
a spouse, the individual, or the individual's spouse must be an EU/EEA national or hold long-term resident status;
if nobody is an EU/EEA national, the child (or each of the two children) must have been born in Malta and be resident in Malta.

constants_used.name: MARRIED_CHILD_TABLES_CUSTODY
constants_used.quote: for the married tables (a)(ii) and (a)(iii), the couple kept the child (or the two children) in their custody. Maintenance does not count for these tables

constants_used.name: MARRIED_2_CHILDREN_2026
constants_used.section: Resident rate tables, basis year 2026 (year of assessment 2027)
constants_used.quote:
Status in the basis year | 0% up to | 15% band (subtract) | 25% band (subtract) | 35% above (subtract)
Married, 2 or more qualifying children, art. 56(1)(a)(iii) | €22,500 | over €22,500 and under €32,000 (€3,375) | over €32,000 and under €60,000 (€6,575) | over €60,000 (€12,575)

constants_used.name: PART_TIME_OPT_OUT
constants_used.quote: Opting out: the person may declare all part-time income in the return at progressive rates. Any final tax already paid is then credited or refunded (article 90A(2)).

constants_used.name: SEPARATE_COMPUTATION_TABLES
constants_used.quote: Married tables (article 56(1)(a)) apply to a married couple resident in Malta and taxed jointly under article 49. If either spouse elected a separate return (article 49A), or the responsible spouse opted for a separate computation (article 50), each spouse uses the article 56(1)(b) tables instead.

constants_used.name: PARENT_TABLE_TEST
constants_used.quote: Parent table (article 56(1)(b)(ii)): the individual was a parent who kept a child in custody, or paid maintenance for the child under article 12(1)(t). The child must be not over 18, or not over 23 if in full-time education.

constants_used.name: PARENT_CHILD_TABLES_CUSTODY
constants_used.quote: for the parent tables (b)(iv) and (b)(v), the individual kept the child in custody (their own child, a spouse's child or a certified cohabitant's child) or paid maintenance for their own child under article 12(1)(t)

constants_used.name: PARENT_2_CHILDREN_2026
constants_used.section: Resident rate tables, basis year 2026 (year of assessment 2027)
constants_used.quote:
Status in the basis year | 0% up to | 15% band (subtract) | 25% band (subtract) | 35% above (subtract)
Parent, 2 or more qualifying children, art. 56(1)(b)(v) | €18,500 | over €18,500 and under €25,500 (€2,775) | over €25,500 and under €60,000 (€5,325) | over €60,000 (€11,325)

constants_used.name: PART_TIME_SPOUSE_EXTENSION
constants_used.quote: Article 90A(9) extends this to a spouse living with a qualifying spouse.

constants_used.name: PART_TIME_FINAL_RATE
constants_used.quote: Rate: 10% from year of assessment 2023 (article 90A(11)). Before that it was 15%. The tax is final, and the income is not declared in the return.

constants_used.name: PART_TIME_SELF_EMPLOYED_CAP
constants_used.quote: Caps (rule 3(2)): the rate covers self-employed profit (article 4(1)(a)) up to €12,000 ... Any excess is declared in the return at normal rates.

constants_used.name: PART_TIME_PAYMENT_DATE
constants_used.quote: Paying as a self-employed part-timer: pay the tax by 30 April of the year after the income was earned.

assumptions: Each spouse's chargeable income is their own, after their own expenses and capital allowances, and leaves out other final-tax income (15% rent option, property transfers)
The children are the couple's children in their custody; a child outside the household for whom a spouse pays maintenance is not handled
Spouse B's part-time income is self-employment profit; part-time employment income (EUR 10,000 cap) and part-time income of spouse A are not handled
No tax credits; social security contributions are not included; resident, not under a special residence programme, no double tax relief

notes: The 10% part-time tax is paid by 30 April 2027 with a statement of accounts; the return and its balance by 30 June 2027
